entities.name: Boii & Germanic Period
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Celtic Boii settled Bohemia (giving it its Latin name), followed by the Germanic Marcomanni under Maroboduus (c. 9 BCE–19 CE). The Marcomannic Wars with Rome (166–180 CE) and subsequent Germanic tribal movements shaped the region.
